title: AI Engineering with Node.js: LLM Apps, Tool Calling & Streaming
concept: Ship LLM features on Node.js that survive production: streaming, token budgets, tool calling, structured output, embeddings and evals, with a simulated model so every challenge is deterministic.
description: Ship LLM features on Node.js that survive production: streaming, token budgets, tool calling, structured output, embeddings and evals, with a simulated model so every challenge is deterministic. 9 lessons, each starting from a real bug or incident, with graded challenges.
